review:
Starlight Princess in holiday colours – same characters, same 6x5 grid. Clusters of 12 or more matching symbols anywhere pay, and tumbles clear winners for new symbols.

Multipliers up to 500x can land on any spin and apply to that tumble sequence. Plays just like Starlight Princess and Gates of Olympus, with a festive theme – an easy pick around the holidays. 96.5% RTP.
